responses.requirement: Furnish relay and protection panels with SCADA interface for a 69 kV substation.
responses.response: Met. Relay and protection panels engineered to the one-line diagram; relays type-tested to IEEE C37.90; SCADA points list agreed at design review.

responses.requirement: Provide protective relays, auxiliary relays and relay programming for a complete, operational switchgear lineup.
responses.response: Met. Feeder overcurrent relays, lockout and auxiliary relays supplied and programmed to the coordination study; settings issued for approval before factory test.

responses.requirement: 15 kV metal-clad switchgear, arc-resistant Type 2B per IEEE C37.20.7.
responses.response: Met. Arc-resistant metal-clad lineup with vacuum breakers; Type 2B accessibility; arc plenum routed per site layout.

responses.requirement: Separate lockable utility cable termination compartment with NEMA pads, insulating boots and ground studs.
responses.response: Met. Standard lockable utility termination compartment; NEMA four-hole pads, insulating boots and ground ball studs from the accessory catalog.

responses.requirement: Overhead busway distribution to 40 racks per hall.
responses.response: Met. Configured busway with tap-off units per rack; standard catalogue ratings.

responses.requirement: 48 V DC rack power with N+1 power supply redundancy.
responses.response: Met. Rack power shelves with N+1 power supply units at 48 V DC; catalog part numbers per rack configuration.
Met. Direct-to-chip cold plates with row-level CDUs sized for 120 kW per rack.

responses.requirement: Deliver racks fully integrated and tested with compute, power and cooling.
responses.response: Met. Rack-scale integration and test of compute trays, power shelves and cold-plate cooling before shipment.
